description: Remote Communities with 3G/4G Mobile Coverage 2021 is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Corporate and Digital Development. Northern Territory communities with 3G/4G mobile network coverage. Cities and towns excluded from dataset Darwin, Palmerston, Tennant Creek, Katherine, Alice Springs and Nhulunbuy. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Corporate and Digital Development. Its tags are GPS Position for Remote Communities, Mobile Coverage, Remote Communites. It offers 2 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2022-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
